headline: Government Requests Authorization to Issue Up to US$33 Billion in External Debt - Diario Panorama
summary: The 2027 Budget bill sent to Congress would authorise up to US$33 billion in external debt, with the Economy Ministry prioritising the lowest-cost financing.
why: External borrowing authorisations signal the government's financing needs and shape the supply of sovereign bonds investors buy.
